mentions.name: Liitmik
mentions.description: A Win/Mac/Linux desktop app for lawyers that points to a filesystem-based project catalog and lets them quickly spin up AI agent sessions by selecting a project via autocomplete search and starting an agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) in an isolated VM, providing strict context management and agent isolation on their own machine.
mentions.problem: Lawyers and similar professionals working with sensitive data need stricter context management and agent isolation than the defaults provide, along with a fast way to create agent sessions.
mentions.audience: Lawyers and other similar professionals working with sensitive data.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Liitmik, www.liitmik.com. It is a win/mac/linux desktop app that lawyers can point to their filesystem-based project catalog and it will then enable them to spin up AI agent sessions quickly by selecting the right project from their catalog via autocomplete search and starting the agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) in an isolated VM.
mentions.author: jkasevits
